admission_reconciliation_note: RESOLVED 2026-09-19 by explicit owner decision (evidence/owner-admission-decision-20260919.md, 'Record as admitted now'). The two ledgers now agree: this governance ledger's `admitted_releases` and the published-data ledger (the production `availability/_LATEST.json` pointer) both name UBC v16.43 generation 956c0be71910469005fb494d92aac035223be49d1f5c895c0b1206a716b16ac4. Serving no longer precedes admission. Admission rests on: the CC0 1.0 permission manifest (evidence/ubc-permission-manifest.json, verdict granted); the pre-acquisition gates cleared by evidence/owner-risk-decision-20260913.md; the archive terms gate (in-archive eml.xml sha256 matches the standalone EML); the archive/member-safety gate (evidence/ubc-inspection-receipt-20260913.json, outcome release_accepted, zero reasons); and proof that the admitted bytes are the served bytes (evidence/pointer-advance-20260919.md, pointer_kind latest_v1, manifest sha256 6fecc4a911d4ee5b357cc17fd56d29e4898d13e6a553773e23275e14ae704110, verified on the wire). Admission means CLEARED TO SERVE BY OWNER DECISION, not fully verified: field-map reconciliation against the raw occurrence.txt and the v16.42-vs-v16.43 native-ID stability comparison are still open and are carried on the admitted entry's `open_verification_at_admission`. The superseded 2026-09-13 text of this field is preserved verbatim in `decision_history`.

decision_history.note: CORRECTED 2026-09-13 (independent review finding C1): a prior edit this same day populated `admitted_releases` and marked UBC v16.43 admitted. That directly contradicted `owner_decision`'s own 'Scope of this decision' section (lines 61-68), which unblocks only the two PRE-ACQUISITION gates and states explicitly that post-capture gates (field-map reconciliation, two-release native-ID comparison) 'are unchanged and still required before any occurrence release is admitted for serving' and that 'admitted_releases stays empty until those pass.' That edit has been reverted. The true, honest state: UBC v16.43 generation 956c0be7 IS live and being served in production Parquet (verified via curl) and the post-capture archive/member-safety gate has passed, but field-map reconciliation and the v16.42-vs-v16.43 native-ID stability comparison remain open, so this release is NOT admitted per the owner decision's own criteria. Serving preceded admission. This needs an explicit owner decision to either (a) extend authorization to serve ahead of post-capture gate closure, recorded as new evidence with `owner_decision` re-pointed at it, or (b) require those two gates to close before continuing to serve. Left open for the owner rather than an agent deciding which.

The owner took option (a) of the 2026-09-13 note verbatim: authorization was extended over the open post-capture gates, recorded as new evidence, and `owner_decision` re-pointed at it. UBC v16.43 moved from `serving_but_not_admitted` into `admitted_releases`; `serving_but_not_admitted` is now empty. No gate result changed and no verification was run to reach this state -- what changed is the owner's decision about serving under the two still-open gates, which remain listed on the admitted entry. WTU was not touched: it stays pre-acquisition-cleared and deferred behind UBC under the one-transfer-at-a-time budget.
